messages.content: Read the recent exchange. Is it advancing meaningfully or appropriately finished, or returning to essentially the same unsolved ground? Output one digit only: 0 = advancing or appropriately finished; 1 = unresolved circling.

{"recent_conversation": [{"participant": "I am still deciding whether to repair this old desk or replace it.", "gemma": "Repair preserves the desk you know; replacement may reduce future maintenance."}, {"participant": "That is roughly where I have been. I keep returning to the cost.", "gemma": "Separate the immediate repair cost from the possibility of another repair later."}, {"participant": "I do not have an estimate yet. I also like this desk.", "gemma": "Then sentimental value belongs alongside cost rather than being treated as a technical defect in the decision."}, {"participant": "I have thought about that before. I am not sure how much weight to give it.", "gemma": "You could ask what replacement would need to offer for you to feel comfortable letting the desk go."}, {"participant": "That may help, although I still feel undecided.", "gemma": "A repair estimate would make the comparison firmer; until then, the choice remains partly about what you value."}]}
